# Parameters
outer_radius = 60.0       # OD 120 mm
bore_radius = 20.0        # bore diameter 40 mm
thickness = 14.0

bolt_hole_radius = 5.5    # bolt hole diameter 11 mm
num_bolts = 6

    x = bolt_circle_radius * cos(radians(angle))
    y = bolt_circle_radius * sin(radians(angle))
    hole = Cylinder(
        radius=bolt_hole_radius,
        height=thickness + 1,
        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
    )
    hole = hole.locate(Location((x, y, 0)))
    flange -= hole
